definitions.explanation: A wall or boundary fence built of stones, often surrounding a traditional house, temple, or castle grounds. Older and more decorative than concrete block walls.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{石塀|いしべい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}っている→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
⟦{城下町|じょうかまち}→城下町：12105_joukamachi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{立派|りっぱ}→立派：01093_rippa⟧な{石塀|いしべい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{並|なら}んでいる→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: Splendid stone walls line the streets of the castle town.

examples.japanese: ⟦{京都|きょうと}→京都：09484_kyouto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{町並|まちな}み→町並み：10435_machinami⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{苔|こけ}→苔：04991_koke⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生|は}えた→生える：02392_haeru⟧{石塀|いしべい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{独特|どくとく}→独特：01656_dokutoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{生|う}み{出|だ}している→生み出す：10423_umidasu⟧。
examples.english: In Kyoto's old townscape, moss-covered stone walls create a distinctive atmosphere.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{石|いし}→石：02177_ishi⟧ (stone) + {塀|べい} (wall, fence). Carries a more traditional, weathered image than its modern counterpart, ⟦ブロック{塀|べい}→ブロック塀：28373_burokkubei⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{石塀|いしべい}: old stone wall
- {石塀|いしべい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{囲|かこ}まれる→囲む：02037_kakomu⟧: be enclosed by a stone wall
- ⟦{苔|こけ}→苔：04991_koke⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生|は}えた→生える：02392_haeru⟧{石塀|いしべい}: moss-covered stone wall
- {石塀|いしべい}{沿|ぞ}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧: walk along a stone wall

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ブロック{塀|べい}→ブロック塀：28373_burokkubei⟧: concrete block wall — modern, mass-produced equivalent
- ⟦{石垣|いしがき}→石垣：19673_ishigaki⟧: stone embankment — built from large stones, often around castles
- {築地塀|ついじべい}: traditional earthen-and-tile wall (around temples)
